Parses a CSS color string into an RGBA object.
Supports: #RGB, #RGBA, #RRGGBB, #RRGGBBAA, rgb(...), rgba(...)
Returns null if the format is unrecognised.

declarations.name: composeAlpha
declarations.description:
Returns an `rgba(...)` color with alpha = 0.4 that is visually
identical to the original color composited over a white (#fff) background.

Math:
  visual  = a_src * C + (1 - a_src) * 255        (composite over white)
  visual  = 0.75  * C' + 0.25       * 255        (target composite)
  C'      = (visual - 63.75) / 0.75               (solve for new channel)

Channel values are clamped to [0, 255].

declarations.name: debounce

parameters.name: debounceMs
parameters.description: The number of milliseconds to delay.
An optional AbortSignal to cancel the debounced function.
parameters.name: options.signal

declarations.description:
Creates a debounced function that delays invoking the provided function until after `debounceMs` milliseconds
have elapsed since the last time the debounced function was invoked. The debounced function also has a `cancel`
method to cancel any pending execution.

declarations.name: watch
declarations.description:
Runs when observed properties change, e.g. @property or @state, but before the component updates. To wait for an
update to complete after a change occurs, use `await this.updateComplete` in the handler. To start watching after the
initial update/render, use `{ waitUntilFirstUpdate: true }` or `this.hasUpdated` in the handler.
